approach: fixed purple-hue round-blob start + hue blobs with perspective size prior + camera-compensated motion peak at the far end + engine SAM lane pass prompted with cuts.json pin_hit_frame
code_changes: none (no path fix needed); run.py ran the YOLO+ORB cache scan itself for each holdout stem
machine_loaded: yes: other agents' run.py jobs (cam-diff, detector-tiling, sam2-video) running at the start, load average 4-9 on 12 cores during the runs

holdout.note: right gutter ball; board clamped to 1.0 from raw -3.7; lane centre 3-4.6 boards off

holdout.failure: track is on the ball to the rack; SAM quad's far edge stops ~40-50 px short of the pin deck and SAM's last_lane_frame (492) is 17 frames before the pin hit, so the board is read against the quad's right edge (raw 0.52) instead of at the rack
SAM lane pass refused ('no calibration', 121 s); window_err [0,0] is the cuts.json value echoed back, not a tracker output

dev_repro.note: fresh track identical to the experiment's (same frames, lane, final_board); original file restored afterwards

inputs_note: run.py reads cuts.json pin_hit_frame (hand-labelled visual frame) as the SAM prompt and the cut bounds encode release; declared by the experiment, applies equally to holdout cuts
verdict_rule: works needs mean recall >= 60 AND board_err <= 3 on >= 3 of 5: recall 98.8 holds but only 2 of 5 boards are within 3. partial = recall >= 40 on >= 3: 5 of 5.
